content: अतिमुक्त {%a.%} .²1 Entirely free from worldly desires, finally emancipated. .²2 Barren, seedless. .²3 Surpassing, (a necklace of) pearls; अतिमुक्तमद्ग्रथितकेसरावली <ls>Māl. 5. 8</ls>. .{@-क्तः, -क्तकः@} .²1 A kind of creeper (माधवी, <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कुसरी</ns> or <ns>कस्तुरमोगरा</ns>) represented as twisting itself round the mango tree and as the beloved of that tree; <ab>cf.</ab> क इदानीं सहकारमन्तरेणातिमुक्तलतां पल्लवितां सहते <ls>Ś. 3</ls>; परिगृहाण गते सहकारतां त्वमतिमुक्तलताचरितं मयि <ls>M. 4. 13</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a tree, Dalbergia Oujeinensis (तिनिश). .²3 (˚क्तकः) Mountain ebony; <ab>N.</ab> of a tree called हरिमन्थ (तिन्दुकवृक्ष, तालवृक्ष also).
